h1: Custom Reflective Shirts for High-Visibility Branding
metaDescription: Order custom reflective shirts for safety and branding. Perfect for construction crews, event staff, and outdoor teams at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom reflective shirts combine high-visibility safety with everyday branding. Safety managers and HR directors choose reflective shirts for construction crews, roadside workers, and event staff who need to be seen in low-light conditions. Our selection includes options with silver reflective tape on moisture-wicking fabrics, suitable for screen printing or embroidery. These shirts meet ANSI standards while keeping your logo visible day or night.
heroAltText: Custom reflective shirts with silver tape stripes on safety orange fabric, ideal for high-visibility work uniforms
